question: When did India first win the first World Cup title in Hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India **won the **first World Cup title** in** Hockey** in **1975, **which was held in** Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.**
 
• In the final match, **India defeated Pakistan** by** 2-1** to lift the trophy.
 
• This was a** historic moment** for Indian hockey as it marked the first time that India had won a **major international tournament **in 15 years.</strong&
